results.fact: Distance to Crescent Creek Basin camp
results.evidence: A West Twin Needle trip report gives 19.5 mi round trip (600-7,936 ft) and describes the camp below Mount Terror as about a mile's traverse from a 6,400 ft bench; a club route page says the col camp near the Chopping Block is 'more than six miles' in. That suggests camp around 7-7.5 mi (matching waypoints[4]), not 9.5, but no source states the trailhead-to-camp distance outright, and changing days 1 and 3 to 7.5 mi would leave the itinerary at 17.5 mi against the stated 19.5 mi round trip. A measured track or a source giving the one-way mileage to the Crescent Creek camp would settle it.
dist_km renders as the ONE-WAY approach; 15.7 km (9.75 mi) one way is consistent with the stated ~19.5 mi (~31 km) round trip and the 9.5 mi summit waypoint.
